title: Two-Link Workspace Explorer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Seven reachability problems for a flat two-link arm: decide whether the tip can reach a target, given the link lengths and an elbow limit. Afterwards, an explore mode lets you change both links and the elbow limit and watch the reachable ring change shape. Used in Chapter 2.

educational.topic: Workspace and reach of a two-link arm
learningObjectives: Solve seven reachability problems for a flat two-link arm by deciding whether a target point lies inside the arm's workspace, with at least 6 of 7 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Calculate, commit, then see the arm try: the ring is hidden until the learner commits
keyQuestions: What is r, and is it between |L1 - L2| and L1 + L2?
How much does the elbow have to bend, and does its limit allow that?
commonMisconceptions: Any point closer than the reach can be touched
Joint limits do not change what the arm can reach
The workspace is a single number
assessmentOpportunities: Seven committed Reachable / Not reachable answers; 6 of 7 for mastery
